name: ThemeHero
description: Responsive theme storytelling hero with a two-column desktop composition, a localized expandable three-line desktop and two-line mobile description, optional size-configurable descriptive Badges, one or two configurable actions and full-bleed mobile artwork.

figma.notes: English Site Optimization 2026 Theme Hero. Desktop preserves the approved two-column composition; mobile adopts W Concept's full-bleed artwork with bottom-aligned copy and a contrast scrim.

description.description: Selectable supporting theme copy clamped to three lines on desktop and two lines on mobile until expanded.

descriptionExpandLabel.description: Localized plain-text action shown only when the responsive description line limit overflows.

descriptionCollapseLabel.description: Localized plain-text action used to restore the responsive description line limit.

tags.description: Optional short descriptive keywords rendered with the shared non-interactive Badge.

tagSize.description: Preferred size for each keyword Badge. Use sm for compact metadata or md for more prominent desktop labels; ThemeHero compacts both to sm geometry below 1024px.

tagTone.description: Filled or outlined polarity for the composed Badges.

image.description: Foreground campaign artwork with meaningful alt text and intrinsic dimensions.

backgroundImageSrc.description: Alternate decorative source for the blurred full-bleed atmosphere; defaults to image.src.

cta.description: Optional primary action rendered with the shared white inverse Button.

secondaryCta.description: Optional lower-emphasis action rendered with the shared transparent inverse Button and a one-pixel outline.

focus.note: The description disclosure, scrollable tag list and composed Buttons supply visible token-backed focus rings.

radius.note: Keyword Badges use the selected desktop size, compact to sm geometry on mobile and retain --radius-tag-primary; both content-width CTAs consume --radius-full, and desktop artwork uses --radius-md.

typeHierarchy.note: The module uses a display heading, heading-sm desktop supporting copy, heading-xs mobile supporting copy and body-xl CTA label.

accessibility.role: section with heading, descriptive copy, optional keyword list, image and optional action group
accessibility.ariaPattern: decorative atmosphere hidden from assistive technology; meaningful foreground image alt; native heading and buttons with optional aria-controls relationships
accessibility.structure: The visible h2 introduces selectable supporting copy, an optional list of non-interactive keyword Badges and up to two actions. The blurred duplicate is decorative; the foreground image is semantic.
accessibility.interaction: Both optional CTAs compose the shared Button and inherit its keyboard, disabled and focus behavior.
